project_type: TypeScript monorepo - Next.js 14 + Phaser game engine + Supabase backend
test_framework: Vitest (unit tests in __tests__/ directories alongside source), Playwright (e2e/ directory for smoke specs)
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm format:check 2. pnpm lint 3. pnpm build 4. pnpm test (all must pass). Additionally pnpm db:verify if SQL changed (needs Docker), pnpm docs:check if Korean docs changed.
snapshot_or_generated_files: docs/MANUAL_WORK_KR.doc is auto-generated from SETUP_GUIDE_KR.md via scripts/build-manual-work-doc.mjs. No snapshot tests.
environment_constraints: No Supabase credentials available locally. No real-time or auth testing possible. Tests must be offline/headless. Docker available for db:verify. All new systems must be testable in isolation without network access.
contribution_requirements: Conventional commits, prettier formatted (printWidth: 88), ESLint --max-warnings=0, no 'any' types, interface preferred over type for objects, one class per file, files <300 lines, tests in __tests__/ dirs, i18n keys for all user-facing strings (12 locales).
key_patterns: ECS: System base class with requiredComponents, Entity with addComponent/getComponent. Pure ops functions (inventoryOps, shopOps, questOps, dialogueOps) keep components as pure data. World systems are pure functions of seed/clock. Item catalogue in @worldnest/shared/items.ts with ItemId union type. Economy in @worldnest/shared/economy.ts. NPC catalogue in game-engine/world/NpcCatalogue.ts. Dialogue trees use i18n keys. Quests: 3 objective kinds (collect/build/talk). Database migrations are numbered SQL files in packages/database/supabase/migrations/. i18n messages are TypeScript objects in apps/web/src/i18n/messages/<locale>.ts.
directory_structure: apps/web/ = Next.js client, packages/game-engine/src/ = ECS core (components/, systems/, ecs/, world/, dialogue/, interaction/, inventory/, quests/, shop/, animation/), packages/shared/src/ = types + item/economy catalogues, packages/database/ = Supabase client + migrations + RPC, packages/ui/ = shared React components, docs/ = architecture + guides, scripts/ = verification scripts, e2e/ = Playwright specs
